tasks.label: build threads (in container)
tasks.command: docker run --platform linux/amd64 --rm --name pintos -it -v "${workspaceFolder}:/pintos" -w /pintos/src/threads thierrysans/pintos make

tasks.label: start gdb (in container)
tasks.command: docker run --platform linux/amd64 --rm --name pintos -it -v "${workspaceFolder}:/pintos" -w /pintos/src/threads/build -p 1234:1234 thierrysans/pintos pintos --gdb -- -q run alarm-multiple
